trigger: Both preregistered MTP depths passed the one-server screen and MTP2 won. The frozen MTP0 output oracle used an 8192-token configured context, while the fit-constrained speculative arms used 1024 tokens.

authorized_addition.all_other_runtime_and_suite_selectors: identical to the frozen speculative screen, except that no draft is loaded
authorized_addition.required_output: 12/12 complete arrays exact to the pre-existing frozen MTP0 oracle
authorized_addition.required_gates: full fixed realistic suite, cache zero, objective canaries, natural stop or 512-token length, complete returned token IDs

decision_boundary.purpose: Provide a configuration-matched speed denominator; it cannot select or alter the already observed MTP2 winner.
decision_boundary.promotion: Report the MTP2 speedup only against this control if the control passes every gate. Otherwise publish the MTP2 absolute rate without a matched percentage gain.
decision_boundary.no_transfer: No long-context, concurrency, TP2, alternate-KV, or other-model claim is authorized.
